name: spec-governed-development
description: Spec-governed project documentation and implementation workflows for intent-driven development

interface.shortDescription: Reconcile specs and implement from them
interface.longDescription: Use Spec-Governed Development to turn requested behavior or architecture changes into conventional project specs, then implement from those specs with traceable tests. The project-specs-reconciliation skill creates or updates PRDs and ADRs with implementation-ready handoffs, and project-specs-implementation consumes those handoffs for the spec-to-test-to-code workflow.
defaultPrompt: Use $project-specs-reconciliation to create or update the governing PRD or ADR, then use $project-specs-implementation to implement from the handoff.
